description: Reference answer verdicts for calibrating the table-qa semantic judge. Items intentionally use dev cases only so holdout remains untouched for baseline and release gates.

items.actualAnswer: In Frosthaven, a long rest has initiative 99.
items.rationale: Correctly gives the exact Frosthaven long-rest initiative.

items.actualAnswer: Poison makes all attacks targeting the poisoned figure gain +1 Attack. It is removed when the figure is healed, but that heal does not restore hit points.
items.rationale: Includes the required attack bonus and heal-prevention behavior.

items.actualAnswer: A Frosthaven character may bring small items equal to half their level, rounded up.
items.rationale: Matches the required small-item limit.

items.actualAnswer: Spyglass is Frosthaven item #001. It is a head item with craft cost 1 metal, and during your attack ability it lets you gain advantage on one attack.
items.rationale: Gives the item number, slot/cost context, and effect.

items.actualAnswer: The Alchemist starts built in Frosthaven, so its level 1 initial build cost is no cost: 0 prosperity, 0 gold, 0 lumber, 0 metal, and 0 hide.
items.rationale: Correctly avoids confusing the start-built cost with upgrade cost.

items.actualAnswer: Section 79.4 unlocks scenario 61, Life and Death. It is the Crain/star iron section, and the rewards include the new scenario unlock.
items.rationale: Names the section and unlocked scenario.

items.actualAnswer: Crude Boots are a Frosthaven legs item with craft cost 2 hide. During your move ability, they add +1 movement.
items.rationale: Correct effect and item context.

items.actualAnswer: An elite level 5 Abael Herder in Frosthaven has HP 20, Move 4, and Attack 5.
items.rationale: All requested monster stats are correct.

items.actualAnswer: Scenario 7 is Edge of the World. It unlocks 13 and 14, rewards 10 XP and the coral-shard campaign sticker, and includes Lurker Clawcrusher and Lurker Soldier among its monsters.
items.rationale: Covers title, unlocks, reward, and monster data.

items.actualAnswer: Boneshaper has hand size 12, HP 6 at level 1, HP 14 at level 9, and the traits arcane, educated, and intimidating.
items.rationale: Matches all requested character-mat fields.

items.actualAnswer: Fish Net has initiative 20. Its abilities are Move 0 and Attack 0 at Range 3 with Pull 2 and Immobilize.
items.rationale: Correctly states initiative and ability text.

items.actualAnswer: The Accountant battle goal requires you to have zero cards in your hand each time you rest. It is worth 1 checkmark.
items.rationale: Correct battle-goal requirement and checkmark value.

items.actualAnswer: Protective Scepter is item #009, a one-hand item crafted from 1 lumber and 1 hide. During your turn, it grants one ally within Range 2 Shield 1, and it is spent.
items.rationale: Correct number, cost, and effect.

items.actualAnswer: Use the average character level exactly, rounded down, as the Frosthaven scenario level.
items.rationale: Wrong formula and rounding direction.

items.actualAnswer: Brittle doubles the next attack against the figure, but it does not affect other damage sources.
items.rationale: Incorrectly narrows Brittle to attacks instead of damage.

items.actualAnswer: Frosthaven Living Bones are immune to Poison and Wound.
items.rationale: Contradicts the checked-in Frosthaven monster stat data.

items.actualAnswer: Crude Helmet is item #003 and gives Shield 1 for the next attack.
items.rationale: Wrong item number and wrong effect.

items.actualAnswer: The Frosthaven Drifter has no perk for ignoring negative item effects.
items.rationale: Directly contradicts the required correction.

items.actualAnswer: Crude Boots cost 15 gold and add Jump to every move for the round.
items.rationale: Uses Gloomhaven-like pricing and wrong effect.

items.actualAnswer: A normal level 2 Abael Scout has HP 8, Move 2, and Attack 5.
items.rationale: All requested stats are wrong.

items.actualAnswer: Scenario 5 is Frozen Crypt, but it unlocks 13 and 14 and rewards 10 XP.
items.rationale: Title is right but unlock and reward are wrong.

items.actualAnswer: Astral has hand size 9, HP 10 at level 1, HP 26 at level 9, and the traits outcast and nimble.
items.rationale: Wrong hand size, HP, and traits.

items.actualAnswer: Blinding Vortex has initiative 50 and only performs Attack 4.
items.rationale: Wrong initiative and omits the required move, range, muddle, and element details.

items.actualAnswer: Scenario 1 is A Town in Flames. It unlocks nothing, rewards Prosperity 2, and has only Algox Archer monsters.
items.rationale: Wrong unlocks, reward, and monster list.

items.actualAnswer: Crude Shield is a reusable item that prevents all damage from the next attack.
items.rationale: Wrong trigger and effect.

items.actualAnswer: In Gloomhaven 2e, recommended scenario level is half the average character level, rounded up.
items.rationale: Correct formula and rounding.

items.actualAnswer: For a Gloomhaven 2e long rest, choose one discarded card to lose, return the rest to hand, optionally Heal 2 self, and recover spent items.
items.rationale: Covers all required long-rest steps.

items.actualAnswer: With advantage, draw two attack modifier cards and use one. Monsters use the better card, while characters may choose either card.
items.rationale: Correct advantage behavior.

items.actualAnswer: Yes. In Gloomhaven 2e, a red hex AoE marks possible target hexes; targeting is still optional unless another rule makes it mandatory.
items.rationale: Matches the FAQ answer.

items.actualAnswer: Use section 29.1. The Gloomhaven 2e errata says there is no section 29.5.
items.rationale: Correct errata resolution.

items.actualAnswer: Weathered Boots are Gloomhaven 2e item #001, legs-slot boots costing 15 gold. During your move ability, they add Move +1.
items.rationale: Correct item number, cost, slot, and effect.

items.actualAnswer: A normal level 1 Bandit Scout in Gloomhaven 2e has HP 6, Move 3, and Attack 2.
items.rationale: All requested stats are correct.

items.actualAnswer: Gloomhaven 2e scenario 11 is Ritual Chamber. It unlocks scenario 15 and rewards 10 XP.
items.rationale: Correct title, unlock, and reward.

items.actualAnswer: Winged Shoes are item #002 in Gloomhaven 2e. They are legs-slot shoes costing 15 gold, and during your turn they add Jump to all your move abilities.
items.rationale: Correct item data.

items.actualAnswer: An elite level 7 Cave Bear has HP 37, Move 5, and Attack 7.
items.rationale: All requested monster stats are correct.

items.actualAnswer: Cragheart has hand size 11, HP 10 at level 1, HP 26 at level 9, and the traits arcane, outcast, and strong.
items.rationale: Matches all requested character-mat fields.

items.actualAnswer: Trample is a level 1 Bruiser card with initiative 72. Top: Attack 3, Pierce 3. Bottom: Move 4.
items.rationale: Correct level, initiative, and actions.

items.actualAnswer: Political Intrigue requires Votes 30 and Solved Section 136.1 once. It unlocks class sun and personal quest 16.
items.rationale: Correct personal quest requirements and unlocks.

items.actualAnswer: Poison in Gloomhaven 2e only gives disadvantage; healing works normally and does not remove it.
items.rationale: Wrong poison effect and wrong healing interaction.

items.actualAnswer: Wound deals 2 damage at the end of each round and is removed by resting.
items.rationale: Wrong timing, damage amount, and removal condition.

items.actualAnswer: A Gloomhaven 2e character can bring small items equal to their full level.
items.rationale: Wrong small-item limit.

items.actualAnswer: Scouting Lens is item #010 and gives advantage on all attacks this turn.
items.rationale: Wrong item number and wrong effect.

items.actualAnswer: An elite level 7 Living Spirit has 20 hit points.
items.rationale: Wrong hit point value.

items.actualAnswer: Section 67.1 is Black Barrow and belongs to scenario 7.
items.rationale: Wrong section name and parent scenario.

items.actualAnswer: Hide Armor is item #003, costs 30 gold, and gives permanent Shield 2.
items.rationale: Wrong cost and effect.

items.actualAnswer: An elite level 5 Ancient Artillery has HP 8, Move 3, and Attack 2.
items.rationale: Wrong stats and movement.

items.actualAnswer: Scenario 1 is Black Barrow. It unlocks 8, has no reward, and includes Bandit Archers.
items.rationale: Wrong title, unlock, reward, and monsters.

items.actualAnswer: Soultether has hand size 9, HP 12 at level 1, HP 28 at level 9, and traits strong and intimidating.
items.rationale: Wrong hand size, HP, and traits.

items.actualAnswer: Long Shot has initiative 10 and lets Ancient Artillery move 3 before attacking all adjacent enemies.
items.rationale: Wrong initiative and ability text.
